versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the 飞书任务对接集成 skill.
- Enables automatic two-way synchronization of local to-do tasks with Feishu Tasks.
- Supports natural language time parsing for task deadlines (e.g., "今天", "明天", "下午3点").
- Allows assignment of task owner and followers, supporting multi-user collaboration.
- Synchronizes task completion status between local and Feishu platforms.
- Detailed configuration and troubleshooting guidelines included.
